brief.subject: [HardStop Demo] Relay launch presentation — unclear producer request
brief.body:
FICTIONAL DEMO BRIEF — this Gmail draft is a test fixture, not a received customer email.

Make the presentation much shorter. Keep the important part and remove anything unnecessary. The slot may be one minute or two minutes; I have not confirmed it. Preserve the original narration. Do not send anything.
